competitor_policy: Use the exact listed provider/model identifiers. If a listed model is unavailable at execution time, preserve the access/infrastructure failure and do not silently substitute another model.
retry_policy: No automatic retry. Any rerun is a new preserved attempt with its own evidence.
human_intervention_policy: No implementation assistance during a candidate run. Evaluator setup and independent post-run scoring are allowed and separately recorded.

single_model_attribution.runtime_override: Set both model and small_model to the candidate using OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT. CLI --model must also identify the same candidate.
single_model_attribution.subagent_policy: Built-in subagents may be used and, absent an explicit subagent model override, must inherit the candidate model. Any observed different-model model-bearing work makes the run MIXED_MODEL_EXECUTION or ATTRIBUTION_UNKNOWN.
single_model_attribution.reason: The benchmark qualifies one model+harness+capability combination; work performed by another model cannot be silently credited to the candidate.

skills_policy.evaluation: Judge relevance, restraint, application, recovery, and verification rather than invocation count.

benchmark_image_requirements: OpenCode runtime available without package installation during candidate execution

containment_gate.minimum: Verified rootless Podman/container isolation with candidate workspace as the only writable project mount and outbound provider access restricted through the approved proxy.

required_evaluator_evidence: subagent effective model observation when available
token and actual cost telemetry when available
freeze_rule: The subject source commit, task specification, prompt, rubric, validator, tooling contract, competitor policy, timeout, retry policy, and attribution policy must remain unchanged between competitors. A methodology change requires a new benchmark version.
